completion_data.completion_summary: Phase 2 of the eight-phase plan, single-phase mission honoured. The evidence probe specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/hit-presented-model-a.lean now exists at 276 lines: a 65-line header carrying every disclaimer the phase mandated (no bound, forward-only with no backward Bool-fixture bridge implied, no decidability claim in any form, nothing about general regular Z-models, the fixture's non-generality because model A's splices are eventually constant in both directions, and the explicit statement that Probe735.not_presented is neither weakened nor retired since one refutes a TRACE-set equality while this record targets a FAMILY-TRIPLE-set equality); the model-A fixture transcribed from presented-not-complete.lean rather than imported, per the collection's convention; and the step-path classification stepA, time_eq, bwd_a, fwd_dichotomy, fwd_absorb, path_classify. path_classify is the rigidity the whole positive construction rests on: every step path through the seam (t, a) is the constant a-path or an a-then-b jump path with jump time w >= t, so the seam's splices form a one-parameter family indexed by w >= t plus the constant path and nothing else. Nothing in this phase mentions HitCl, hitOf or HitPresented; no bound of any kind is established and none is claimed.

memory_candidates.content: A research dispatch that leaves a COMPILED scratch file behind, plus a report that records which tactic choices were load-bearing, can collapse an implementation phase to a pure transcription that compiles green on the first attempt with zero proof search. The load-bearing details worth recording are exactly the ones a re-derivation would get wrong: induction principle AND case names (Int.induction_on with zero/succ/pred), the ORDER of normalization versus rewriting (push_cast at h ih before a show-by-ring step, not after), deprecation substitutions already made (simp only [not_exists] in place of push_neg), and toolchain quirks (an explicit propositional hypothesis per theorem, because the toolchain does not auto-include a propositional variable). Record these in the report, not just the final proof text.

A pre-commit gate keyed to one directory's line count does not fire for every Lean-adding commit. In BimodalLogic, typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 pins formalsystem-line-count, so a phase adding hundreds of Lean lines under specs/evidence/ sails through while a 44-line FormalSystem/ edit is blocked. Before budgeting the full-build-plus---fix remedy into every phase of a plan, check WHICH directory the gate counts against the phase's actual file scope; a blanket 'every later phase will hit this gate' note in a handoff can be wrong in the cheap direction and cause needless build runs.

An evidence probe living under specs/ is reachable by no Lake target root, so lake build never compiles it and a full green project build is NOT evidence the probe compiles. The two are independent checks: run the probe's own lake env lean compile line explicitly, and treat the probe as ungated until it is wired into the repository's probe-checking script. A phase that lands such a probe and reports only the project build has reported nothing about its own output.
